task.title: Relics: settle the shape of the design relic before storing it
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M77). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

The steps that store the approved relics design as the first relic are written and rehearsed, but three things about the result are not settled. Twelve of the 60 decision parts repeat the body of their section, because a tagged heading becomes both. The six relics plans and some story text still name the HTML file's path, which stops existing. The Decided and Proposed tags become plain text and the page styling is lost.

## Wanted

Decide each point, then change the conversion script and the held steps to match.

## Done when

- Each of the three points has a recorded decision.
- The conversion script and its rehearsal pass with the decided shape, in zsh and in fish.

## Notes

This comes before the held steps of "Relics: teach agents to use relics and store the design as the first relic" are run in the real repository.
